name: Sam
bio: Sam has been 'running the show' for years without knowing anyone else was backstage. Tired, but trying.
quote: Okay. One thing at a time. Where did I put my keys?

name: Pip
bio: Pip is about six and loves dogs, crayons, and the color orange. He fronts when things feel safe and soft.
quote: Can we get the dino nuggets? Please please please?

name: Jo
bio: Jo keeps a mental spreadsheet of everything. She gets twitchy when the calendar is empty.
quote: I made a list of our lists.

name: Ash
bio: Ash hums when it's nervous, and somehow that calms everyone else too.
quote: Breathe in for four. You've got this. We've got this.

name: Benny
bio: Benny is sixteen forever and has opinions about everyone's music. Great at carrying groceries.
quote: Ugh, fine. But I'm picking the playlist.

name: Wren
bio: Wren doodles in the margins of every notebook the system owns. Nobody minds.
quote: What if we painted the kitchen... teal?

name: Toby
bio: Toby reminds everyone to drink water. And eat. And maybe go to bed at a normal time?
quote: Did we eat lunch? Be honest.

name: Mira
bio: Mira can small-talk with anyone, about anything, for any length of time.
quote: Oh, I'll make the call. Phones don't scare me.

name: Rook
bio: Rook stands at the door of the headspace with arms crossed. Gruff, loyal, secretly soft about Pip.
quote: Nobody's getting to us. Not today.

name: Juniper
bio: Juniper keeps the headspace garden and the real-world houseplants alive. Mostly.
quote: Tea first. Then we can panic, if we still want to.

name: Dex
bio: Dex sees who's close to front and helps switches go smoothly. Talks like a sysadmin.
quote: Switch queued. Please stand by.

name: Lulu
bio: Lulu is seven and three-quarters. She narrates her life like a fairy tale.
quote: And then the brave princess went to the post office!

name: Morgan
bio: Morgan handles bills, forms, and anything with fine print. Owns several highlighters.
quote: Section 4, paragraph 2. They can't charge us that.

name: Kit
bio: Kit identifies with a fox spirit from a story the system loved as a kid. Quick, clever, restless.
quote: Zoomies! Er. I mean, let's go for a walk.

name: Ellis
bio: Ellis holds a lot of the old stuff so others don't have to. Quiet, thoughtful, steady.
quote: I remember. That's okay. It's mine to carry for now.

name: Sunny
bio: Sunny lights up a room and sings in the shower. Loudly.
quote: Parties are just hangouts with snacks!

name: Vesper
bio: Vesper comes forward when the world gets loud. Speaks softly; nobody argues.
quote: I'll take it from here. Rest.

name: Theo
bio: Theo speedruns chores like they're video games. Surprisingly effective.
quote: New personal best on dishes. Any%.

name: Nana Rose
bio: Nana Rose is the warm grandmotherly figure the system always needed. Makes soup for every problem.
quote: Sit down, sweetheart. I'll put the kettle on.

name: Quill
bio: Quill writes everything down: system journals, poems, grocery lists in iambic pentameter.
quote: Let me write this down before it floats away.

name: Bolt
bio: Bolt identifies as a helpful robot. Beeps when happy. Extremely good at schedules.
quote: BEEP. Task acknowledged. Executing.

name: Marisol
bio: Marisol handles customer-service calls with terrifying politeness.
quote: I completely understand. Now let me speak to your supervisor.

name: Haven
bio: Haven tends the paths between rooms of the headspace and knows where everyone is.
quote: Everyone's accounted for. You're safe.

name: Captain
bio: Captain fronts for confrontations, landlords, and anyone who raises their voice. Never loses his cool.
quote: We will be discussing this calmly. Now.

name: Echo
bio: Echo keeps the system's history like a librarian. Remembers every appointment, every name.
quote: Your last visit was March 3rd. You mentioned the headaches.

name: Bramble
bio: Bramble plays guitar in the headspace meadow. The music drifts everywhere.
quote: Let's go outside. Just for a minute. Feel the air.

name: Ivy
bio: Ivy runs work like a well-oiled machine. Her inbox is at zero. Always.
quote: I've blocked out focus time. Do not schedule over it.

name: Bun
bio: Bun is a tiny ball of joy who reminds everyone that play is important too.
quote: Blanket fort! Blanket fort! Everyone in!

name: Atlas
bio: Atlas carries the heavy stuff, literally and figuratively. Gives the best inner-world hugs.
quote: Hand it here. I've got it.

name: Orion
bio: Orion watches over the whole system like a lighthouse keeper. When he's near front, everything clicks.
quote: I see all of you. Let's work together.

name: Seraphine
bio: Seraphine is a magical-girl fictive with endless confidence. Sparkles are mandatory.
quote: Fear not! Your heroine has arrived~

name: Nova
bio: Nova is the life of every party and the reason the system has friends at all.
quote: Hi! I'm Nova! Wanna be friends? Too late, we are now.

name: Sage
bio: Sage is the system's quiet center. Grounding, wise, and very hard to rattle.
quote: Notice five things you can see. Good. Now four you can touch.

name: Jett
bio: Jett is fast, sharp, and fiercely protective. Handles emergencies before anyone else notices them.
quote: Already handled. You're welcome.
